rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent low-rise mass across all four views, not as colliding fragments. It has a legible dominant bar-like body with a modest stepped/angled roof condition, and the parcel is respected rather than merely boxed. The blue access edge is answered only weakly: there is some ground-level indention/entry seam, but the street response is more sealed than public. The visible form still plausibly supports neighborhood-living/commercial mixed use because it can accommodate an active ground threshold and a compact upper mass, though the current void logic is underdeveloped. It passes program fit because the silhouette and section remain compatible with a small mixed-use street building; it is not a wrong typology.
